channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: AKP prepares to hand new charter draft to Erdoğan: Report
item.description: Officials from the ruling Justice and Development Party (AKP) are preparing to present the first draft of a new constitution to President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, daily Milliyet reported on Feb. 23.

item.title: Türkiye to establish invasive alien species list, monitoring system
item.description: Türkiye is set to establish a national invasive alien species list and set up a nationwide monitoring system to prevent the entry and spread of invasive alien species across the country, in accordance with a new regulation prepared by the Agriculture and Forestry Ministry published in the Official Gazette.

item.title: Rising gold prices impact Türkiye’s current account deficit
item.description: A $100 increase in the price of gold per ounce translates into an estimated $400 million negative impact on Türkiye’s current account balance, according to Turkish Miners Association President Mehmet Yılmaz.

item.title: Food and energy drive household inflation concerns
item.description: The Central Bank of Türkiye reported that households’ 12-month-ahead annual inflation expectations remained unchanged from the previous month, standing at 48.81 percent, according to the Households Expectations Survey released on Feb. 24.

item.title: Marriages decline, divorce rates rise in Türkiye in 2025: Data
item.description: Marriage rates in Türkiye declined in 2025, while divorce rates continued to climb, according to newly released data on marriage and divorce statistics by the Turkish Statistical Institute (TÜİK).

item.title: Türkiye emerges as AI powerhouse in its region
item.description: Türkiye is carving out a leading role in artificial intelligence across Eastern and Southeastern Europe, standing as the only country in the region to produce AI unicorns — companies valued at over $1 billion.

item.title: Mexico deploys 10,000 troops to end violence over drug lord's death
item.description: Mexico has deployed 10,000 troops to quell clashes sparked by the killing of the country's most-wanted drug lord that claimed dozens of lives, officials said Monday.

item.title: Iran would react 'ferociously' to any US attack, warns of regional conflict
item.description: Iran vowed on Monday to retaliate "ferociously" against any attack from the United States, and repeated its warning of a regional conflagration in response to President Donald Trump's latest threat of strikes.

item.title: Ukraine marks four years since Russian invasion
item.description: Ukraine was on Tuesday marking the fourth anniversary of Russia's full-scale invasion, with a show of solidarity from its staunchest allies and no immediate end in sight to Europe's bloodiest conflict since World War II.

item.title: Türkiye, partners condemn Israeli West Bank measures as ‘de facto annexation’
item.description: Türkiye, the Arab League, the Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC), and 18 other countries on Monday condemned “in the strongest terms” a series of recent Israeli decisions to drastically extend unlawful Israeli control over the West Bank.
